title.zh: 肌肉力臂：我们的模型 vs MyoFullBody（MuJoCo）
title.en: Muscle moment arms: our model vs MyoFullBody (MuJoCo)

method.zh: 对每一对（肌肉，坐标）：其余关节在解剖学零位，把该坐标在“我们的活动范围 ∩ 参照的范围”内分 9 点扫过，两边各得一条长度—角度曲线。平均力臂 = −(末长 − 初长) / 扫过的弧度，正值表示这个运动使肌肉缩短。我们的长度取变形后肌肉网格的中心线（14 段质心连线，带作用线的肌肉以作用线两端收尾），ourLineArmMm 是只用作用线（起止点直线）得到的值。参照的长度按节段长度之比缩放到我们的身材（下肢：股骨+胫骨；上肢：肱骨+前臂；手：腕到 MCP3 到 PIP3；躯干：L5/S1 到胸锁关节的高度）。多个肌束的参照取平均。上臂抬高用胸肱角（含肩带节律），腰部运动按范围分到五个腰椎关节，参照的躯干主坐标先换算成胸廓相对骶骨的实际转角。
method.en: For every (muscle, coordinate) pair: with the other joints at the anatomical zero, the coordinate is swept in 9 steps over the intersection of our range of motion and the reference range, giving one length-versus-angle curve on each side. Mean moment arm = −(final length − initial length) / swept angle in radians; positive means the movement shortens the muscle. Our length is the centreline of the deformed muscle mesh (centroids of 14 slices, closed by the ends of the line of action where the rig has one); ourLineArmMm is the value from the line of action alone (straight, origin to insertion). Reference lengths are scaled to our body by a ratio of segment lengths (leg: femur + tibia; arm: humerus + forearm; hand: wrist to MCP3 to PIP3; trunk: height from L5/S1 to the sternoclavicular joint). The reference value is the mean over fascicles. Arm elevation is thoracohumeral (girdle rhythm included); lumbar movements are spread over our five lumbar joints by their ranges, and the reference trunk master coordinate is first converted into the actual rotation of the thorax against the sacrum.

tolerance.zh: |我们 − 参照| ≤ max(8 mm, 参照力臂的 35%) 记为 within。这个容差是本项目定的：参照本身是由少数标本和 MRI 做成的通用模型，不是人群分布；8 mm 约为网格中心线法的分辨率。超出时再分：符号相反（opposite sign）、偏小（too small）、偏大（too large）。
tolerance.en: |ours − reference| ≤ max(8 mm, 35 % of the reference arm) counts as within. The tolerance is this project's choice: the reference is itself a generic model built from a few specimens and MRI, not a population distribution, and 8 mm is about the resolution of the mesh-centreline method. Outside it the row is classed as opposite sign, too small or too large.

references.name: MyoSim (MyoHub/myo_sim): MuJoCo musculoskeletal models MyoLeg, MyoArm, MyoHand, MyoTorso, composed as MyoFullBody
references.version: MyoHub/myo_sim commit 93b0ca8f (2026-09-16); evaluated with the PyPI package myo-sim 0.2.3 (model "myofullbody": 123 joints, 416 muscle actuators) in MuJoCo 3.15.0

notes.zh: 参照是“量具”不是真值：两个模型都是由少数尸体标本和 MRI 做成的通用成年人模型，肌肉是带途经点和缠绕面的折线。MyoLeg 源自 Rajagopal 模型、MyoArm 源自 MoBL 上肢模型、MyoTorso 源自 SimTK 的腰椎模型，所以下肢的两张表并不独立。我们这一侧，变形后网格的中心线会低估绕过关节的肌肉的长度变化（蒙皮把肌肉沿骨拉伸，不绕行）；表里的差别首先说明“这块肌肉的形状随关节变化得不像参照”，不一定是附着点错了。
notes.en: The references are instruments, not ground truth: both are generic adult models built from a few cadaver specimens and MRI, with muscles as polylines through via points and over wrap surfaces. MyoLeg derives from the Rajagopal model, MyoArm from the MoBL upper-extremity model and MyoTorso from the SimTK lumbar spine model, so the two leg tables are not independent. On our side, the centreline of a skinned mesh under-reads the length change of a muscle that wraps round a joint (skinning stretches the muscle along the bone and does not wrap); a disagreement first says that the muscle's shape does not follow the joint as the reference does, not necessarily that an attachment is wrong.

notes.zh: 参照的长度由 MuJoCo 求值（tools/calibrate/myo_dump.py）：逐个独立关节扫过它的范围，从动关节按模型里的等式约束（多项式耦合）跟随，缠绕由 MuJoCo 计算。
notes.en: Reference lengths are evaluated by MuJoCo (tools/calibrate/myo_dump.py): each independent joint is swept over its range, dependent joints follow the model's equality constraints (polynomial couplings), and wrapping is computed by MuJoCo.
